snippet.title: Fun Times at Homer's - OFFICIAL TEASER TRAILER - Nick Person Developed
snippet.description:
yeah this is happening.
Play the game: https://gamejolt.com/games/Fun_Times_at_Homer_1/323639

Fun Times at Homer's is a Fan Game of highly popular and such cultural shock that is The Simpsons merged with our iconic Five Nights at Freddy's. Experience Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, Maggie, Hugo, Apu, and many other Simpsons classics as scary horror animatronics trying to Jumpscare you in this spooky yet comedy packed game experience!

Music of the end: Pete Heller - Big Love

This parody is based on FNaF from Scott Cawthon, And The Simpsons is from Matt Groening, this game is just a parody game made for fun to people enjoy, Thanks for giving us both Simpsons and FNaF! they were amazing creations and I appreciate them a lot :D
